source.build: portal local DEV 3b98939b (round 8), 0 tracked changes; origin/DEV carries none of it
source.note: No client names or client dollar figures; screenshots stay in tmp/ui-walk/ (gitignored).

outcomes.O1: Performance reads as a finished answer: no 'not supplied' tiles, no raw data dump, no system words on the face.
outcomes.O2: Every period button either answers or says in plain words why it cannot, over a real date range.
outcomes.O3: Holdings charts stay legible at any account count: readable labels, distinct colours, negatives handled, long lists reachable.
outcomes.O4: No system name, code or unknown placeholder reaches the face or its first click.
outcomes.O5: Analysis setup behaves like a form: a selection takes, defaults fit the client, errors wait for input.
outcomes.O6: The request list is the viewer's own and speaks client language.

findings.observed: On a computed 49F report (YTD 5.93%), VS BENCHMARK, ENDING VALUE and BEGINNING VALUE all read 'not supplied'.

cause.text: The adapter's answer carries no benchmark and no period values for this account; the page renders each missing field as a tile.

findings.acceptance: A computed report shows only the figures it has; a missing benchmark or value is one plain line, never three 'not supplied' tiles.

findings.observed: Under the cumulative chart the page lists every daily point as a table row (about 185 rows), making the page over 6,000 px tall.

cause.text: The series table is rendered in full below the chart.

findings.acceptance: The daily series is one click away (or paged); the default view is the chart and the period figures.

findings.observed: Report details on a computed report shows 'Partial -- Qualified answer -- not a complete report', PERFORMANCE_PARTIAL, TIME_WEIGHTED, OPAL_ENGINE and three revision hashes.

cause.text: The details panel prints the report's provenance fields verbatim.

findings.acceptance: Report details states the method and source in client words (for example 'Time-weighted, net of fees; Opal's performance engine'); codes and hashes stay out of the page.

findings.observed: The 'Monthly returns and accounts' table carries rows whose account, ending value and coverage cells read 'not supplied'.

cause.text: Rows are built for fields the answer does not carry.

findings.acceptance: The monthly table lists only rows it can fill, or states once what is not available.

findings.observed: The account picker keeps 'YTD pending' (or 'YTD unavailable') after the YTD figure has rendered, and still says 'YTD' while 3Y or Since inception is selected.

cause.text: The picker's suffix is computed once at load and not tied to the selected period.

findings.acceptance: The picker's figure follows the selected period and updates when it computes.

findings.observed: For the 49F three-account client, 3Y and Since inception answer 'Unavailable' with the raw code UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION and a 'Contact support' button, no plain words.

cause.text: The adapter refuses those windows (UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION, 3 answers in the walk); the page shows the code instead of a sentence.

findings.acceptance: A window the service cannot answer says so in words (what is supported, what to choose instead); no code on the face. Owner of the capability: IRPT_BCKEND (~P).

findings.observed: 'Since inception' requests 1970-01-01 to 2026-09-22 (INF and 49F clients).

cause.text: The preset uses a fixed epoch start, not the account's inception date.

findings.acceptance: 'Since inception' starts at the account's first data point (or its opening date).

findings.observed: The INF refusal reads 'This account is not covered for performance reporting. It becomes available once this account is added to the covered set for this firm.'

cause.text: The OBJECT_NOT_COVERED refusal is worded in system terms.

findings.acceptance: The refusal names, in client words, why the figure is missing and who can make it available.

findings.observed: While a report loads, the canvas reads 'Loading  No source age yet'; a refusal reads 'Unavailable  No source age yet'.

cause.text: A provenance label is rendered before there is a source.

findings.acceptance: Loading is a loading state with no system words; 'source age' never shows before a source exists.

findings.observed: With 4 (INF) or 11 (COT) accounts, the pie's slice labels overlap into an unreadable pile.

cause.text: Every slice gets an on-chart label regardless of size.

findings.acceptance: Labels never overlap: small slices move to the legend (or a leader line).

findings.observed: The accounts pie draws 4 or 11 slices in near-identical greys and dark navies; neighbouring slices cannot be told apart.

cause.text: The account palette is a narrow grey ramp.

findings.acceptance: Adjacent slices are distinguishable at a glance (a palette with enough separation for 11+ accounts).

findings.observed: One account of the COT eleven-account client is NEGATIVE (about -4.6% of the client) and sits in the accounts table and legend of a pie.

cause.text: A pie cannot draw a negative share; the negative row is kept in the list.

findings.acceptance: A negative account is shown as a separate, labelled line (never as a pie slice), and the pie's shares sum to the positive total it states.

findings.observed: For the COT eleven-account client, the Over what list shows 10 rows and cuts the next one in half; there is no 'show all'.

cause.text: The expanded list has a fixed height with hidden overflow.

findings.acceptance: Every account is reachable from Over what (a 'show all' or a scroll affordance); no row is clipped.

findings.observed: The Holdings footer reads 'Source: holdings_snapshot.build_cot.', an internal function name.

cause.text: The footer prints the snapshot's producer field.

findings.acceptance: The source line names the data source in client words (for example 'Black Diamond, as of ...').

findings.observed: INF model holdings list bare tickers (FDRXX, CIVIX, VO ...) with no security names.

cause.text: INF name facts are not yet served.

findings.acceptance: Every security shows its name beside its ticker.

findings.observed: INF account labels read '****9749 / INDIVIDUAL RETIREMENT AC' (the type text is cut off) on every surface.

cause.text: The registration type arrives truncated from the source field.

findings.acceptance: An account's type reads in full ('Individual Retirement Account').

findings.observed: 'About this scope' shows 'SCOPE AS OF: unknown' for every client walked (49F, INF, COT).

cause.text: The scope's as-of is not carried to the page.

findings.acceptance: The scope panel shows a real date or omits the field.

findings.observed: Pressing 'Multi-Comp' leaves 'Variant: Overview (0 comparisons)' and shows 'Multi-Comp does not match 0 comparison(s); Overview does.'; the selected card is barely distinguishable.

cause.text: The variant is derived from the comparison count, so a card press alone does not change it, and the mismatch is reported as a validation sentence.

findings.acceptance: Pressing a card selects it visibly and the form asks for what that variant needs (for example 'Add at least two models'); no system sentence.

findings.observed: For multi-account clients the default report title names ONE account ('<client> ****8774 / UTMA -- Overview'), and the title field shows the name with trailing asterisks.

cause.text: The default title is built from the selection's first account label.

findings.acceptance: The default title names the client (and the variant), never one account of several.

findings.observed: 'Enter the report recipient (up to 200 characters).' shows as a red error before anything has been typed.

cause.text: Validation runs on load.

findings.acceptance: Required-field messages appear after the user tries to generate (or leaves the field), not on load.

findings.observed: The comparison input's placeholder is cut off: 'Opal model or ETF symbo'.

cause.text: The input is narrower than its placeholder.

findings.acceptance: No placeholder or label is truncated at 1440 px.

findings.observed: While the snapshot loads, Analysis shows 'Holdings snapshot: none held -- Loading' and the red refusal 'No holdings snapshot is held for this scope.' for a client whose Holdings tab shows holdings.

cause.text: The refusal renders before the snapshot read returns.

findings.acceptance: Analysis shows a loading state until the snapshot read answers; a refusal only after it answers.

findings.observed: Signed in as the admin walker, 'Your analysis requests' lists requests other principals submitted (windows 7-15), each as 'Open REQ-<24-hex> . revision 1' with 'Unavailable -- ANALYSIS_REQUIRES_ATTENTION' or 'Status unavailable' (including window 15's READY job).

cause.text: The list is not owner-scoped for an admin viewer, prints raw ids and codes, and the status reads fail until irpt-status is redeployed (~D 101985 known gap).

findings.acceptance: The list shows the viewer's own requests (or is labelled as all requests for an admin), each by client name, variant and date, with a status in words; a READY job reads Ready.

No sample content behind the open search list.
Each entry shows its value; the labels stay identical until UIR-26's labels (Monday).
Over what still lists identical labels (data, UIR-26).
Export is grey on Analysis with no report.
Two accounts draw two distinct colours (but see UIC-11 at 4+ accounts).
The display name is right, but the firm still shows twice (chip and identity line).
The breadcrumb now names the account; the strategy still reads '*9238' against '****9237', two masking styles.
A one-child level still draws a one-slice pie.
Blue still marks a model and Equity; orange a model and Alternatives.
Round 9: several navy bands remain (3 on the empty page).
Map chips are grouped by account.
Two date formats remain, and the source line is now an internal name (UIC-14).
